title: corethrogyne californica var. incana
intro: Corethrogyne californica var. incana, commonly known as California everlasting, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, potentially helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of California everlasting include astringent, antiseptic, and vulnerary properties, making it useful for treating minor cuts and burns. The bioactive constituents of Corethrogyne californica var. incana include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to confirm the exact effects of these compounds on human health.
